title: Voting to Banish Your Most Annoying Neighbor
hook: Every year, Athenians gathered in the agora to exile one powerful politician for ten whole years.

scenes.text: In classical Athens, democracy had a ruthless safeguard against tyranny: an annual election called 'ostracism'.
scenes.imagePrompt: The sprawling sunlit Agora marketplace of ancient Athens surrounded by marble porticoes and olive trees. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In classical Athens, democracy had a ruthless safeguard against tyranny: an annual election called 'ostracism'.

scenes.text: Citizens gathered in the central marketplace and scratched the name of the politician they found most dangerous onto a broken pottery shard called an 'ostrakon'.
scenes.imagePrompt: Broken terracotta pottery shards with scratched ancient Greek lettering and an iron stylus resting on marble steps. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Citizens gathered in the central marketplace and scratched the name of the politician they found most dangerous onto a broken pottery shard called an 'ostrakon'.

scenes.text: If at least six thousand votes were cast, the individual with the highest tally was banished from Athens for ten full years.
scenes.imagePrompt: Bronze ballot urns and wicker tally baskets placed on a stone voting platform under a striped awning. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: If at least six thousand votes were cast, the individual with the highest tally was banished from Athens for ten full years.

scenes.text: They weren't accused of any crime, and their property wasn't confiscated—they were simply exiled because people were tired of their ambition.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dusty coastal road leading away from Athens toward the distant Aegean sea at sunset. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: They weren't accused of any crime, and their property wasn't confiscated—they were simply exiled because people were tired of their ambition.

scenes.text: Aristides 'The Just' was once asked by an illiterate voter to write Aristides' own name on a shard. When asked why, the voter replied: 'I'm sick of hearing everyone call him Just!'
